import json

# Rules derived from the given data:
# 1. Proto *d- (initial) -> t-   (dikiʔ->takiʔ, dilah->talàh, dalam etc.)
# 2. Proto *ə in the first syllable -> a   (bəsey -> pathey)
# 3. Voiceless medial stop p stays p; the grave accent (à) appears only when the
#    medial consonant was originally voiced (b, d, r, l, j), as in padam->patàm,
#    bara->pirà. Here the medial is voiceless p, so no grave accent.
# 4. Final -a stays -a when no voiced medial lowering applies (mata -> mɨta).

proto = "dəpa"

def derive(p):
    out = []
    # initial consonant
    first = p[0]
    out.append({"d": "t"}.get(first, first))
    # first-syllable vowel
    out.append({"ə": "a"}.get(p[1], p[1]))
    # medial consonant
    med = p[2]
    voiced = med in "bdjrlg"
    out.append(med)  # voiceless p kept
    last = p[3]
    if voiced and last == "a":
        last = "à"
    out.append(last)
    return "".join(out)

ans = derive(proto)
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": ans,
    "evidence": {
        "proto": "*" + proto,
        "rules": ["d->t initial", "ə->a first syllable",
                  "voiceless medial p blocks grave lowering"],
        "parallels": ["dikiʔ->takiʔ", "bəsey->pathey", "mata->mɨta"]
    }
}, ensure_ascii=False))
